define void @"L.List_u64.reverse(L.List_u64*)"(ptr %this) {
entry:

  store i32 %1, ptr %sh, align 4
  %sh.val = load i32, ptr %sh, align 4
  %2 = load ptr, ptr @glShaderSource, align 8
  call void %2(i32 %sh.val, i32 1, ptr %src.addr, ptr null)
  %sh.val1 = load i32, ptr %sh, align 4
  %3 = load ptr, ptr @glCompileShader, align 8
  call void %3(i32 %sh.val1)
  store i32 0, ptr %ok, align 4
  %sh.val2 = load i32, ptr %sh, align 4
  %COMPILE_STATUS.val = load i32, ptr @COMPILE_STATUS, align 4
  %4 = load ptr, ptr @glGetShaderiv, align 8
  call void %4(i32 %sh.val2, i32 %COMPILE_STATUS.val, ptr %ok)
  %ok.val = load i32, ptr %ok, align 4
  %eqtmp = icmp eq i32 %ok.val, 0
  %ifcond = icmp ne i1 %eqtmp, false
  br i1 %ifcond, label %then, label %ifcont

then:                                             ; preds = %entry
  store i32 0, ptr %n, align 4
  %sh.val3 = load i32, ptr %sh, align 4
  %lastLog.val = load ptr, ptr @lastLog, align 8
  %5 = load ptr, ptr @glGetShaderInfoLog, align 8
  call void %5(i32 %sh.val3, i32 4095, ptr %n, ptr %lastLog.val)
  %sh.val4 = load i32, ptr %sh, align 4
  %6 = load ptr, ptr @glDeleteShader, align 8
  call void %6(i32 %sh.val4)
  ret i32 0

ifcont:                                           ; preds = %entry
  %sh.val5 = load i32, ptr %sh, align 4
  ret i32 %sh.val5
}

define i32 @"OGL.program(Char*,Char*)"(ptr %vs, ptr %fs) {

  %p = alloca i32, align 4

  store ptr %fs, ptr %fs.addr, align 8
  %index.base = load ptr, ptr @lastLog, align 8
  %index.ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %index.base, i32 0
  store i8 0, ptr %index.ptr, align 1
  %VERTEX_SHADER.val = load i32, ptr @VERTEX_SHADER, align 4

then:                                             ; preds = %entry

ifcont:                                           ; preds = %entry

ifcont5:                                          ; preds = %ifcont

  %v.val10 = load i32, ptr %v, align 4
  %8 = load ptr, ptr @glDeleteShader, align 8
  call void %8(i32 %v.val10)
  %f.val11 = load i32, ptr %f, align 4
  %9 = load ptr, ptr @glDeleteShader, align 8
  call void %9(i32 %f.val11)
  store i32 0, ptr %ok, align 4
  %p.val12 = load i32, ptr %p, align 4
  %LINK_STATUS.val = load i32, ptr @LINK_STATUS, align 4
  %10 = load ptr, ptr @glGetProgramiv, align 8
  call void %10(i32 %p.val12, i32 %LINK_STATUS.val, ptr %ok)
  %ok.val = load i32, ptr %ok, align 4

  br i1 %ifcond14, label %then15, label %ifcont18

then15:                                           ; preds = %ifcont5

  %11 = load ptr, ptr @glGetProgramInfoLog, align 8

  %p.val17 = load i32, ptr %p, align 4
  %12 = load ptr, ptr @glDeleteProgram, align 8
  call void %12(i32 %p.val17)
  ret i32 0

ifcont18:                                         ; preds = %ifcont5
  %p.val19 = load i32, ptr %p, align 4
  ret i32 %p.val19
}

define i32 @"OGL.textureRGBA(UInt8*,Int32,Int32)"(ptr %px, i32 %w, i32 %h) {
entry:
  %t = alloca %OGL.Texture, align 8
  %h.addr = alloca i32, align 4
  %w.addr = alloca i32, align 4
  %px.addr = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %px, ptr %px.addr, align 8
  store i32 %w, ptr %w.addr, align 4
  store i32 %h, ptr %h.addr, align 4
  store %OGL.Texture zeroinitializer, ptr %t, align 8
  %px.val = load ptr, ptr %px.addr, align 8
  %w.val = load i32, ptr %w.addr, align 4
  %h.val = load i32, ptr %h.addr, align 4

  %0 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %OGL.Texture, ptr %t, i32 0, i32 0
  %1 = load i32, ptr %0, align 4
  ret i32 %1
}

define void @"Core.panic(Char*)"(ptr %msg) {
entry:
  %msg.addr = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %msg, ptr %msg.addr, align 8
  %0 = call i32 @fflush(ptr @"Core.stdout()")
  %1 = call i32 @fputs(ptr @utf8str.48, ptr @"Core.stderr()")
  %msg.val = load ptr, ptr %msg.addr, align 8
  %2 = call i32 @fputs(ptr %msg.val, ptr @"Core.stderr()")
  %3 = call i32 @fputs(ptr @utf8str.49, ptr @"Core.stderr()")
  %4 = call i32 @fflush(ptr @"Core.stderr()")
  call void @exit(i32 1)
  ret void
}

define void @"Core.assert(Bool,Char*)"(i1 %cond, ptr %msg) {
entry:
  %msg.addr = alloca ptr, align 8
  %cond.addr = alloca i1, align 1
  store i1 %cond, ptr %cond.addr, align 1
  store ptr %msg, ptr %msg.addr, align 8
  %cond.val = load i1, ptr %cond.addr, align 1
  %booltmp = icmp ne i1 %cond.val, false
  %nottmp = xor i1 %booltmp, true
  %ifcond = icmp ne i1 %nottmp, false
  br i1 %ifcond, label %then, label %ifcont

then:                                             ; preds = %entry
  %0 = call i32 @fflush(ptr @"Core.stdout()")
  %1 = call i32 @fputs(ptr @utf8str.50, ptr @"Core.stderr()")
  %msg.val = load ptr, ptr %msg.addr, align 8
  %2 = call i32 @fputs(ptr %msg.val, ptr @"Core.stderr()")
  %3 = call i32 @fputs(ptr @utf8str.51, ptr @"Core.stderr()")
  %4 = call i32 @fflush(ptr @"Core.stderr()")
  call void @exit(i32 1)
  br label %ifcont

ifcont:                                           ; preds = %then, %entry
  ret void
}

define void @"Core.unreachable()"() {
entry:
  %0 = call i32 @fflush(ptr @"Core.stdout()")
  %1 = call i32 @fputs(ptr @utf8str.52, ptr @"Core.stderr()")
  %2 = call i32 @fflush(ptr @"Core.stderr()")
  call void @exit(i32 1)
  ret void
}

define void @"Core.swapMem(Void*,Void*,UInt64)"(ptr %a, ptr %b, i64 %n) {
entry:
  %t = alloca i8, align 1
  %i = alloca i64, align 8
  %pb = alloca ptr, align 8
  %pa = alloca ptr, align 8
  %n.addr = alloca i64, align 8
  %b.addr = alloca ptr, align 8
  %a.addr = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %a, ptr %a.addr, align 8
  store ptr %b, ptr %b.addr, align 8
  store i64 %n, ptr %n.addr, align 8
  %a.val = load ptr, ptr %a.addr, align 8
  store ptr %a.val, ptr %pa, align 8
  %b.val = load ptr, ptr %b.addr, align 8
  store ptr %b.val, ptr %pb, align 8
  store i64 0, ptr %i, align 8
  br label %for.cond

for.cond:                                         ; preds = %for.inc, %entry
  %i.val = load i64, ptr %i, align 8
  %n.val = load i64, ptr %n.addr, align 8
  %ulttmp = icmp ult i64 %i.val, %n.val
  %forcond = icmp ne i1 %ulttmp, false
  br i1 %forcond, label %for.body, label %for.end

for.body:                                         ; preds = %for.cond
  %i.val1 = load i64, ptr %i, align 8
  %index.base = load ptr, ptr %pa, align 8
  %index.ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %index.base, i64 %i.val1
  %load.index = load i8, ptr %index.ptr, align 1
  store i8 %load.index, ptr %t, align 1
  %i.val2 = load i64, ptr %i, align 8
  %index.base3 = load ptr, ptr %pa, align 8
  %index.ptr4 = getelementptr i8, ptr %index.base3, i64 %i.val2
  %i.val5 = load i64, ptr %i, align 8
  %index.base6 = load ptr, ptr %pb, align 8
  %index.ptr7 = getelementptr i8, ptr %index.base6, i64 %i.val5
  %load.index8 = load i8, ptr %index.ptr7, align 1
  store i8 %load.index8, ptr %index.ptr4, align 1
  %i.val9 = load i64, ptr %i, align 8
  %index.base10 = load ptr, ptr %pb, align 8
  %index.ptr11 = getelementptr i8, ptr %index.base10, i64 %i.val9
  %t.val = load i8, ptr %t, align 1
  store i8 %t.val, ptr %index.ptr11, align 1
  br label %for.inc

for.inc:                                          ; preds = %for.body
  %i.val12 = load i64, ptr %i, align 8
  %incdec = add i64 %i.val12, 1
  store i64 %incdec, ptr %i, align 8
  store i64 %incdec, ptr %i, align 8
  br label %for.cond

for.end:                                          ; preds = %for.cond
  ret void
}

define void @"VK.zero(Void*,UInt64)"(ptr %p, i64 %n) {
entry:
  %n.addr = alloca i64, align 8
  %p.addr = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %p, ptr %p.addr, align 8
  store i64 %n, ptr %n.addr, align 8
  %p.val = load ptr, ptr %p.addr, align 8
  %n.val = load i64, ptr %n.addr, align 8
  %0 = call ptr @memset(ptr %p.val, i32 0, i64 %n.val)
  ret void
}

define i64 @"VK.forever()"() {
entry:
  %m = alloca i64, align 8
  store i64 0, ptr %m, align 8
  %m.val = load i64, ptr %m, align 8
  %subtmp = sub i64 %m.val, 1
  store i64 %subtmp, ptr %m, align 8
  %m.val1 = load i64, ptr %m, align 8
  ret i64 %m.val1
}

define void @"VK.copyBytes(UInt8*,UInt8*,UInt64)"(ptr %dst, ptr %src, i64 %n) {
entry:
  %i = alloca i64, align 8
  %n.addr = alloca i64, align 8
  %src.addr = alloca ptr, align 8
  %dst.addr = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %dst, ptr %dst.addr, align 8
  store ptr %src, ptr %src.addr, align 8
  store i64 %n, ptr %n.addr, align 8
  store i64 0, ptr %i, align 8
  br label %while.cond

while.cond:                                       ; preds = %while.body, %entry
  %i.val = load i64, ptr %i, align 8
  %n.val = load i64, ptr %n.addr, align 8
  %ulttmp = icmp ult i64 %i.val, %n.val
  %whilecond = icmp ne i1 %ulttmp, false
  br i1 %whilecond, label %while.body, label %while.end

while.body:                                       ; preds = %while.cond
  %i.val1 = load i64, ptr %i, align 8
  %index.base = load ptr, ptr %dst.addr, align 8
  %index.ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %index.base, i64 %i.val1
  %i.val2 = load i64, ptr %i, align 8
  %index.base3 = load ptr, ptr %src.addr, align 8
  %index.ptr4 = getelementptr i8, ptr %index.base3, i64 %i.val2
  %load.index = load i8, ptr %index.ptr4, align 1
  store i8 %load.index, ptr %index.ptr, align 1
  %i.val5 = load i64, ptr %i, align 8
  %addtmp = add i64 %i.val5, 1
  store i64 %addtmp, ptr %i, align 8
  br label %while.cond

while.end:                                        ; preds = %while.cond
  ret void
}

define ptr @"VK.readFile(Char*,UInt64*)"(ptr %path, ptr %outSize) {
entry:
  %got = alloca i64, align 8
  %buf = alloca ptr, align 8
  %n = alloca i32, align 4
  %f = alloca ptr, align 8
  %outSize.addr = alloca ptr, align 8
  %path.addr = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %path, ptr %path.addr, align 8
  store ptr %outSize, ptr %outSize.addr, align 8
  %path.val = load ptr, ptr %path.addr, align 8
  %0 = call ptr @fopen(ptr %path.val, ptr @utf8str.53)
  store ptr %0, ptr %f, align 8
  %f.val = load ptr, ptr %f, align 8
  %eqtmp = icmp eq ptr %f.val, null
  %ifcond = icmp ne i1 %eqtmp, false
  br i1 %ifcond, label %then, label %ifcont

then:                                             ; preds = %entry
  ret ptr null

ifcont:                                           ; preds = %entry
  %f.val1 = load ptr, ptr %f, align 8
  %1 = call i32 @fseek(ptr %f.val1, i32 0, i32 2)
  %f.val2 = load ptr, ptr %f, align 8
  %2 = call i32 @ftell(ptr %f.val2)
  store i32 %2, ptr %n, align 4
  %f.val3 = load ptr, ptr %f, align 8
  %3 = call i32 @fseek(ptr %f.val3, i32 0, i32 0)
  %n.val = load i32, ptr %n, align 4
  %letmp = icmp sle i32 %n.val, 0
  %ifcond4 = icmp ne i1 %letmp, false
  br i1 %ifcond4, label %then5, label %ifcont7

then5:                                            ; preds = %ifcont
  %f.val6 = load ptr, ptr %f, align 8
  %4 = call i32 @fclose(ptr %f.val6)
  ret ptr null

ifcont7:                                          ; preds = %ifcont
  %n.val8 = load i32, ptr %n, align 4
  %int.cast = sext i32 %n.val8 to i64
  %5 = call ptr @malloc(i64 %int.cast)
  store ptr %5, ptr %buf, align 8
  %buf.val = load ptr, ptr %buf, align 8
  %n.val9 = load i32, ptr %n, align 4
  %int.cast10 = sext i32 %n.val9 to i64
  %f.val11 = load ptr, ptr %f, align 8
  %6 = call i64 @fread(ptr %buf.val, i64 1, i64 %int.cast10, ptr %f.val11)
  store i64 %6, ptr %got, align 8
  %f.val12 = load ptr, ptr %f, align 8
  %7 = call i32 @fclose(ptr %f.val12)
  %got.val = load i64, ptr %got, align 8
  %n.val13 = load i32, ptr %n, align 4
  %int.cast14 = sext i32 %n.val13 to i64
  %netmp = icmp ne i64 %got.val, %int.cast14
  %ifcond15 = icmp ne i1 %netmp, false
  br i1 %ifcond15, label %then16, label %ifcont18

then16:                                           ; preds = %ifcont7
  %buf.val17 = load ptr, ptr %buf, align 8
  call void @free(ptr %buf.val17)
  ret ptr null

ifcont18:                                         ; preds = %ifcont7
  %index.base = load ptr, ptr %outSize.addr, align 8
  %index.ptr = getelementptr i64, ptr %index.base, i32 0
  %n.val19 = load i32, ptr %n, align 4
  %int.cast20 = sext i32 %n.val19 to i64
  store i64 %int.cast20, ptr %index.ptr, align 8
  %buf.val21 = load ptr, ptr %buf, align 8
  ret ptr %buf.val21
}

define i1 @"VK.layerPresent(Char*)"(ptr %name) {
entry:
  %b = alloca i8, align 1
  %a = alloca i8, align 1
  %k = alloca i64, align 8
  %more = alloca i1, align 1
  %same = alloca i1, align 1
  %base = alloca i64, align 8
  %i = alloca i32, align 4
  %found = alloca i1, align 1
  %props = alloca ptr, align 8
  %n = alloca i32, align 4
  %name.addr = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %name, ptr %name.addr, align 8
  store i32 0, ptr %n, align 4
  %0 = call i32 @vkEnumerateInstanceLayerProperties(ptr %n, ptr null)
  %n.val = load i32, ptr %n, align 4
  %eqtmp = icmp eq i32 %n.val, 0
  %ifcond = icmp ne i1 %eqtmp, false
  br i1 %ifcond, label %then, label %ifcont

define float @"C.msqrt(Float)"(float %x) {
entry:

  %g = alloca float, align 4
  %x.addr = alloca float, align 4

  %x.val = load float, ptr %x.addr, align 4
  %fletmp = fcmp ole float %x.val, 0.000000e+00
  %ifcond = icmp ne i1 %fletmp, false
  br i1 %ifcond, label %then, label %ifcont

then:                                             ; preds = %entry
  ret float 0.000000e+00

  %faddtmp = fadd float %x.val1, 1.000000e+00
  %fmultmp = fmul float %faddtmp, 5.000000e-01
  store float %fmultmp, ptr %g, align 4
  store i32 0, ptr %i, align 4

define void @"C.matIdentity(Float*)"(ptr %m) {

while.body:                                       ; preds = %while.cond

  %r.val22 = load i32, ptr %r, align 4

define float @"C.chan(UInt32,Int32)"(i32 %c, i32 %shift) {
entry:
  %v = alloca i32, align 4
  %shift.addr = alloca i32, align 4
  %c.addr = alloca i32, align 4
  store i32 %c, ptr %c.addr, align 4
  store i32 %shift, ptr %shift.addr, align 4
  %c.val = load i32, ptr %c.addr, align 4
  %shift.val = load i32, ptr %shift.addr, align 4
  %lshrtmp = lshr i32 %c.val, %shift.val
  %andtmp = and i32 %lshrtmp, 255
  store i32 %andtmp, ptr %v, align 4
  %v.val = load i32, ptr %v, align 4
  %sitofp = sitofp i32 %v.val to float
  %fdivtmp = fdiv float %sitofp, 2.550000e+02
  ret float %fdivtmp
}

define void @"C.copyBytes(UInt8*,UInt8*,UInt64)"(ptr %dst, ptr %src, i64 %n) {
entry:
  %i = alloca i64, align 8
  %n.addr = alloca i64, align 8
  %src.addr = alloca ptr, align 8
  %dst.addr = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %dst, ptr %dst.addr, align 8
  store ptr %src, ptr %src.addr, align 8
  store i64 %n, ptr %n.addr, align 8
  store i64 0, ptr %i, align 8
  br label %while.cond

while.cond:                                       ; preds = %while.body, %entry
  %i.val = load i64, ptr %i, align 8
  %n.val = load i64, ptr %n.addr, align 8
  %ulttmp = icmp ult i64 %i.val, %n.val
  %whilecond = icmp ne i1 %ulttmp, false
  br i1 %whilecond, label %while.body, label %while.end

while.body:                                       ; preds = %while.cond
  %i.val1 = load i64, ptr %i, align 8
  %index.base = load ptr, ptr %dst.addr, align 8
  %index.ptr = getelementptr i8, ptr %index.base, i64 %i.val1
  %i.val2 = load i64, ptr %i, align 8
  %index.base3 = load ptr, ptr %src.addr, align 8
  %index.ptr4 = getelementptr i8, ptr %index.base3, i64 %i.val2
  %load.index = load i8, ptr %index.ptr4, align 1
  store i8 %load.index, ptr %index.ptr, align 1
  %i.val5 = load i64, ptr %i, align 8
  %addtmp = add i64 %i.val5, 1
  store i64 %addtmp, ptr %i, align 8
  br label %while.cond

while.end:                                        ; preds = %while.cond
  ret void
}

define i32 @"C.clampi(Int32,Int32,Int32)"(i32 %v, i32 %lo, i32 %hi) {
entry:

define i1 @"W.Window.open(W.Window*,Int32,Int32,Char*,Bool)"(ptr %this, i32 %w, i32 %h, ptr %title, i1 %opengl) {
entry:
  %opengl.addr = alloca i1, align 1
  %title.addr = alloca ptr, align 8
  %h.addr = alloca i32, align 4
  %w.addr = alloca i32, align 4
  store i32 %w, ptr %w.addr, align 4
  store i32 %h, ptr %h.addr, align 4
  store ptr %title, ptr %title.addr, align 8
  store i1 %opengl, ptr %opengl.addr, align 1
  %opengl.val = load i1, ptr %opengl.addr, align 1
  %ifcond = icmp ne i1 %opengl.val, false
  br i1 %ifcond, label %then, label %else

then:                                             ; preds = %entry
  %GLFW_CONTEXT_VERSION_MAJOR.val = load i32, ptr @GLFW_CONTEXT_VERSION_MAJOR, align 4
  call void @glfwWindowHint(i32 %GLFW_CONTEXT_VERSION_MAJOR.val, i32 3)
  %GLFW_CONTEXT_VERSION_MINOR.val = load i32, ptr @GLFW_CONTEXT_VERSION_MINOR, align 4
  call void @glfwWindowHint(i32 %GLFW_CONTEXT_VERSION_MINOR.val, i32 3)
  %GLFW_OPENGL_PROFILE.val = load i32, ptr @GLFW_OPENGL_PROFILE, align 4
  %GLFW_OPENGL_CORE_PROFILE.val = load i32, ptr @GLFW_OPENGL_CORE_PROFILE, align 4
  call void @glfwWindowHint(i32 %GLFW_OPENGL_PROFILE.val, i32 %GLFW_OPENGL_CORE_PROFILE.val)
  br label %ifcont

else:                                             ; preds = %entry
  %GLFW_CLIENT_API.val = load i32, ptr @GLFW_CLIENT_API, align 4
  %GLFW_NO_API.val = load i32, ptr @GLFW_NO_API, align 4
  call void @glfwWindowHint(i32 %GLFW_CLIENT_API.val, i32 %GLFW_NO_API.val)
  br label %ifcont

ifcont:                                           ; preds = %else, %then
  %0 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %W.Window, ptr %this, i32 0, i32 0
  %w.val = load i32, ptr %w.addr, align 4

  %1 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %W.Window, ptr %this, i32 0, i32 1

  br i1 %ifcond1, label %then2, label %ifcont3

ifcont3:                                          ; preds = %ifcont

then6:                                            ; preds = %ifcont3

define void @"W.Window.close(W.Window*)"(ptr %this) {
entry:
  %0 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %W.Window, ptr %this, i32 0, i32 0
  %1 = load ptr, ptr %0, align 8
  %netmp = icmp ne ptr %1, null
  %ifcond = icmp ne i1 %netmp, false
  br i1 %ifcond, label %then, label %ifcont

  %2 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %W.Window, ptr %this, i32 0, i32 0
  %3 = load ptr, ptr %2, align 8
  call void @glfwDestroyWindow(ptr %3)
  %4 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %W.Window, ptr %this, i32 0, i32 0
  store ptr null, ptr %4, align 8
  br label %ifcont

ifcont:                                           ; preds = %then, %entry
  ret void
}

}

define i1 @"W.Window.isMinimized(W.Window*)"(ptr %this) {
entry:
  %hh = alloca i32, align 4
  %w = alloca i32, align 4
  store i32 0, ptr %w, align 4
  store i32 0, ptr %hh, align 4
  %0 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %W.Window, ptr %this, i32 0, i32 0
  %1 = load ptr, ptr %0, align 8
  call void @glfwGetFramebufferSize(ptr %1, ptr %w, ptr %hh)
  %w.val = load i32, ptr %w, align 4
  %eqtmp = icmp eq i32 %w.val, 0
  %lhscond = icmp ne i1 %eqtmp, false
  br i1 %lhscond, label %sc.merge, label %sc.rhs

sc.rhs:                                           ; preds = %entry
  %hh.val = load i32, ptr %hh, align 4
  %eqtmp1 = icmp eq i32 %hh.val, 0
  %rhscond = icmp ne i1 %eqtmp1, false
  br label %sc.merge

sc.merge:                                         ; preds = %sc.rhs, %entry
  %lortmp = phi i1 [ true, %entry ], [ %rhscond, %sc.rhs ]
  ret i1 %lortmp
}

  %sitofp2 = sitofp i32 %hh.val1 to float

define void @"OGL.Mesh.uploadLayout(OGL.Mesh*,Float*,Int32,Int32*,Int32)"(ptr %this, ptr %verts, i32 %floatCount, ptr %layout, i32 %attrCount) {
entry:
  %off = alloca i32, align 4
  %i = alloca i32, align 4
  %stride = alloca i32, align 4
  %attrCount.addr = alloca i32, align 4
  %layout.addr = alloca ptr, align 8
  %floatCount.addr = alloca i32, align 4
  %verts.addr = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %verts, ptr %verts.addr, align 8
  store i32 %floatCount, ptr %floatCount.addr, align 4
  store ptr %layout, ptr %layout.addr, align 8
  store i32 %attrCount, ptr %attrCount.addr, align 4
  store i32 0, ptr %stride, align 4

while.cond:                                       ; preds = %while.body, %entry

  %8 = load ptr, ptr @glBufferData, align 8

define i32 @"VK.Vulkan.findMemoryType(VK.Vulkan*,UInt32,UInt32)"(ptr %this, i32 %typeBits, i32 %want) {
entry:

  %i = alloca i32, align 4
  %r = alloca i32, align 4
  %n = alloca i32, align 4

  store i32 %want, ptr %want.addr, align 4

  %1 = load ptr, ptr %0, align 8
  %index.ptr = getelementptr i32, ptr %1, i32 0

  %lhscond = icmp ne i1 %ulttmp, false
  br i1 %lhscond, label %sc.rhs, label %sc.merge

sc.rhs:                                           ; preds = %while.cond
  %r.val = load i32, ptr %r, align 4
  %eqtmp = icmp eq i32 %r.val, -1
  %rhscond = icmp ne i1 %eqtmp, false
  br label %sc.merge

sc.merge:                                         ; preds = %sc.rhs, %while.cond
  %landtmp = phi i1 [ false, %while.cond ], [ %rhscond, %sc.rhs ]
  %whilecond = icmp ne i1 %landtmp, false
  br i1 %whilecond, label %while.body, label %while.end

while.body:                                       ; preds = %sc.merge
  store i32 1, ptr %bit, align 4
  %bit.val = load i32, ptr %bit, align 4
  %i.val1 = load i32, ptr %i, align 4
  %shltmp = shl i32 %bit.val, %i.val1
  store i32 %shltmp, ptr %bit, align 4
  %typeBits.val = load i32, ptr %typeBits.addr, align 4
  %bit.val2 = load i32, ptr %bit, align 4
  %andtmp = and i32 %typeBits.val, %bit.val2
  %netmp = icmp ne i32 %andtmp, 0
  %lhscond3 = icmp ne i1 %netmp, false

sc.rhs4:                                          ; preds = %while.body

  %3 = load ptr, ptr %2, align 8

  %addtmp = add i32 1, %multmp
  %index.ptr7 = getelementptr i32, ptr %3, i32 %addtmp

  %want.val = load i32, ptr %want.addr, align 4

  %want.val10 = load i32, ptr %want.addr, align 4
  %eqtmp11 = icmp eq i32 %andtmp9, %want.val10
  %rhscond12 = icmp ne i1 %eqtmp11, false
  br label %sc.merge5

sc.merge5:                                        ; preds = %sc.rhs4, %while.body
  %landtmp13 = phi i1 [ false, %while.body ], [ %rhscond12, %sc.rhs4 ]
  %ifcond = icmp ne i1 %landtmp13, false

then:                                             ; preds = %sc.merge5

define void @"VK.Vulkan.destroyTexture(VK.Vulkan*,VK.Texture*)"(ptr %this, ptr %t) {
entry:

define i32 @"C.Pen2D.createShader(C.Pen2D*,Char*)"(ptr %this, ptr %fragBody) {
entry:
  %p = alloca i32, align 4
  %src = alloca ptr, align 8
  %fragBody.addr = alloca ptr, align 8
  store ptr %fragBody, ptr %fragBody.addr, align 8
  %0 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %C.Pen2D, ptr %this, i32 0, i32 19
  %1 = load i32, ptr %0, align 4
  %API_GL.val = load i32, ptr @API_GL, align 4
  %netmp = icmp ne i32 %1, %API_GL.val
  %ifcond = icmp ne i1 %netmp, false
  br i1 %ifcond, label %then, label %ifcont

then:                                             ; preds = %entry
  ret i32 0

ifcont:                                           ; preds = %entry
  %2 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %C.Pen2D, ptr %this, i32 0, i32 0
  %3 = load ptr, ptr %2, align 8
  call void @glfwMakeContextCurrent(ptr %3)
  %4 = call ptr @"C.fs2dPrefix()"()
  %fragBody.val = load ptr, ptr %fragBody.addr, align 8
  %5 = call ptr @"C.catStr(Char*,Char*)"(ptr %4, ptr %fragBody.val)
  store ptr %5, ptr %src, align 8
  %6 = call ptr @"C.vs2d()"()
  %src.val = load ptr, ptr %src, align 8
  %7 = call i32 @"OGL.program(Char*,Char*)"(ptr %6, ptr %src.val)
  store i32 %7, ptr %p, align 4
  %src.val1 = load ptr, ptr %src, align 8
  call void @free(ptr %src.val1)
  %p.val = load i32, ptr %p, align 4
  ret i32 %p.val
}

define void @"C.Pen2D.freeShader(C.Pen2D*,UInt32)"(ptr %this, i32 %p) {
entry:
  %p.addr = alloca i32, align 4
  store i32 %p, ptr %p.addr, align 4
  %p.val = load i32, ptr %p.addr, align 4
  %eqtmp = icmp eq i32 %p.val, 0
  %ifcond = icmp ne i1 %eqtmp, false
  br i1 %ifcond, label %then, label %ifcont

then:                                             ; preds = %entry
  ret void

ifcont:                                           ; preds = %entry
  %0 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %C.Pen2D, ptr %this, i32 0, i32 19
  %1 = load i32, ptr %0, align 4
  %API_GL.val = load i32, ptr @API_GL, align 4
  %eqtmp1 = icmp eq i32 %1, %API_GL.val
  %ifcond2 = icmp ne i1 %eqtmp1, false
  br i1 %ifcond2, label %then3, label %ifcont5

then3:                                            ; preds = %ifcont
  %2 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %C.Pen2D, ptr %this, i32 0, i32 0
  %3 = load ptr, ptr %2, align 8
  call void @glfwMakeContextCurrent(ptr %3)
  %p.val4 = load i32, ptr %p.addr, align 4
  %4 = load ptr, ptr @glDeleteProgram, align 8
  call void %4(i32 %p.val4)
  br label %ifcont5

ifcont5:                                          ; preds = %then3, %ifcont
  ret void
}

define void @"C.Pen2D.circle(C.Pen2D*,Float,Float,Float,UInt32)"(ptr %this, float %cx, float %cy, float %r, i32 %c) {
entry:
  %nxt = alloca i32, align 4
  %a = alloca float, align 4
  %i = alloca i32, align 4
  %base = alloca i32, align 4
  %v = alloca float, align 4
  %u = alloca float, align 4
  %segs = alloca i32, align 4
  %c.addr = alloca i32, align 4
  %r.addr = alloca float, align 4
  %cy.addr = alloca float, align 4
  %cx.addr = alloca float, align 4
  store float %cx, ptr %cx.addr, align 4
  store float %cy, ptr %cy.addr, align 4
  store float %r, ptr %r.addr, align 4
  store i32 %c, ptr %c.addr, align 4
  store i32 32, ptr %segs, align 4
  %0 = call float @"C.Pen2D.whiteU(C.Pen2D*)"(ptr %this)
  store float %0, ptr %u, align 4
  %1 = call float @"C.Pen2D.whiteV(C.Pen2D*)"(ptr %this)
  store float %1, ptr %v, align 4
  %2 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %C.Pen2D, ptr %this, i32 0, i32 8
  %3 = load i32, ptr %2, align 4
  call void @"C.Pen2D.ensure(C.Pen2D*,UInt32,UInt32,Float,Float)"(ptr %this, i32 %3, i32 0, float 0.000000e+00, float 0.000000e+00)
  %4 = getelementptr inbounds nuw %C.Pen2D, ptr %this, i32 0, i32 9
  %5 = load i32, ptr %4, align 4
  store i32 %5, ptr %base, align 4
  %cx.val = load float, ptr %cx.addr, align 4
  %cy.val = load float, ptr %cy.addr, align 4
  %u.val = load float, ptr %u, align 4
  %v.val = load float, ptr %v, align 4
  %c.val = load i32, ptr %c.addr, align 4
  call void @"C.Pen2D.vert(C.Pen2D*,Float,Float,Float,Float,UInt32)"(ptr %this, float %cx.val, float %cy.val, float %u.val, float %v.val, i32 %c.val)
  store i32 0, ptr %i, align 4
  br label %while.cond

while.cond:                                       ; preds = %while.body, %entry
  %i.val = load i32, ptr %i, align 4
  %segs.val = load i32, ptr %segs, align 4
  %lttmp = icmp slt i32 %i.val, %segs.val
  %whilecond = icmp ne i1 %lttmp, false
  br i1 %whilecond, label %while.body, label %while.end

while.body:                                       ; preds = %while.cond
  %i.val1 = load i32, ptr %i, align 4
  %sitofp = sitofp i32 %i.val1 to float
  %fmultmp = fmul float %sitofp, 2.000000e+00
  %PI.val = load float, ptr @PI, align 4
  %fmultmp2 = fmul float %fmultmp, %PI.val
  %segs.val3 = load i32, ptr %segs, align 4
  %sitofp4 = sitofp i32 %segs.val3 to float
  %fdivtmp = fdiv float %fmultmp2, %sitofp4
  store float %fdivtmp, ptr %a, align 4
  %cx.val5 = load float, ptr %cx.addr, align 4
  %a.val = load float, ptr %a, align 4
  %6 = call float @"C.mcos(Float)"(float %a.val)
  %r.val = load float, ptr %r.addr, align 4
  %fmultmp6 = fmul float %6, %r.val
  %faddtmp = fadd float %cx.val5, %fmultmp6
  %cy.val7 = load float, ptr %cy.addr, align 4
  %a.val8 = load float, ptr %a, align 4

  %r.val9 = load float, ptr %r.addr, align 4
  %fmultmp10 = fmul float %7, %r.val9
  %faddtmp11 = fadd float %cy.val7, %fmultmp10
  %u.val12 = load float, ptr %u, align 4
  %v.val13 = load float, ptr %v, align 4
  %c.val14 = load i32, ptr %c.addr, align 4
  call void @"C.Pen2D.vert(C.Pen2D*,Float,Float,Float,Float,UInt32)"(ptr %this, float %faddtmp, float %faddtmp11, float %u.val12, float %v.val13, i32 %c.val14)
  %i.val15 = load i32, ptr %i, align 4
  %addtmp = add i32 %i.val15, 1
  store i32 %addtmp, ptr %i, align 4
  br label %while.cond

while.end:                                        ; preds = %while.cond
  store i32 0, ptr %i, align 4
  br label %while.cond16

while.cond16:                                     ; preds = %while.body21, %while.end
  %i.val17 = load i32, ptr %i, align 4
  %segs.val18 = load i32, ptr %segs, align 4
  %lttmp19 = icmp slt i32 %i.val17, %segs.val18
  %whilecond20 = icmp ne i1 %lttmp19, false
  br i1 %whilecond20, label %while.body21, label %while.end30

while.body21:                                     ; preds = %while.cond16
  %i.val22 = load i32, ptr %i, align 4
  %addtmp23 = add i32 %i.val22, 1
  %segs.val24 = load i32, ptr %segs, align 4
  %modtmp = srem i32 %addtmp23, %segs.val24
  store i32 %modtmp, ptr %nxt, align 4
  %i.val25 = load i32, ptr %i, align 4
  %addtmp26 = add i32 %i.val25, 1
  %nxt.val = load i32, ptr %nxt, align 4
  %addtmp27 = add i32 %nxt.val, 1
  %base.val = load i32, ptr %base, align 4
  call void @"C.Pen2D.tri(C.Pen2D*,UInt32,UInt32,UInt32,UInt32)"(ptr %this, i32 0, i32 %addtmp26, i32 %addtmp27, i32 %base.val)
  %i.val28 = load i32, ptr %i, align 4
  %addtmp29 = add i32 %i.val28, 1
  store i32 %addtmp29, ptr %i, align 4
  br label %while.cond16

while.end30:                                      ; preds = %while.cond16
  %segs.val31 = load i32, ptr %segs, align 4
  %multmp = mul i32 %segs.val31, 3
  call void @"C.Pen2D.grow(C.Pen2D*,UInt32)"(ptr %this, i32 %multmp)
  ret void
}
